About the Medical Innovation event

Medical Innovation is a Teamwork event in the HOSA secondary division. Format: speech & presentation · online submission.

Ten in-depth lessons for the HOSA Medical Innovation team event (2–4 secondary or postsecondary members), following the 2026–27 guidelines: finding a real health care need, checking originality against prior art and patents, designing and prototyping an original innovation, explaining its impact on health care delivery, quality of life and costs, describing training, careers and regulation, building the 13-slide Round One outline (110 points) and a compliant stand-alone exhibit, and delivering the five-minute Round Two presentation and demonstration (130 points). Includes design-thinking, decision-matrix, cost and break-even drills and practice scenarios.

Impact on delivery and quality of life, costs and implementation.
